rationale: The message and the title are correct and clear. The only defect is a placeholder value: the report site for query expressions passes 'LINQ', which wrongly suggests that LINQ is not supported at all, although the LINQ method syntax is supported in templates.
codeChange: In TemplateAnnotator.VisitQueryExpression (Metalama.Framework.Engine/Templating/TemplateAnnotator.cs, around line 2670), pass "LINQ query syntax" instead of "LINQ" as the feature name, so that the message reads 'LINQ query syntax' is not supported in a template.
